notes.title: Hoops Madness OFFICIAL RELEASE! LEAVING EARLY ACCESS!!!
notes.notes:
Full Cross-Platform Support, Usability, Networking/Multiplayer, & Content Updates & Improvements. 

Hey Hoopers! The Hoops Madness Team has been hard at work with a number of updates while we prepare for Full Release. We're excited to announce a major update to increase the competition, its social aspects, and make shooting hoops feel even better. [b]BUT[/b] we are REALLY excited to announce that we are transitioning out of Early Access!!! Are you ready to Play, Connect, & Compete?!

This update is [b]PACKED [/b]with usability improvements, networking enhancements, & content updates so that the only thing standing in your way are your competitors. ːsteamhappyː

[h1]New Features[/h1]

[list]
[*][b]Full Cross-Platform Support:[/b] Added in cross-play between all the major headsets (we will be cross-play compliant with the Quest once we are live on Oculus App Lab!) & VR platforms (Steam, Oculus Rift, & Viveport). The home “Court” just became even bigger & more expansive!
[*] [b]SteamVR support for Quest 1 & Quest 2 via the link cable & experimental support for Windows Mixed Reality. More competition = More fun![/b] 
[*] [b]New slimmed down ball racks & ball spawning feature:[/b] You will always have a ball to shoot with and won’t need to fight over them with your competitors. You also won't need to wait for balls to respawn on the ball rack! ːsteamhappyː
[*] [b]Player Hand IK (inverse kinematics) Update:[/b] More efficient and hand poses look good when the ball is equipped to the hand.
[*] [b]All New Lighting:[/b] Gettin' the mood right!
[*] [b]New & Clearer Audio Mix:[/b] Players can now hear the balls hitting the court floor and bouncing off of the backboard.
[*] [b]Added doors in the Stadium Scene:[/b] Provides a more polished and cohesive look.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Addressed latency ball offset issue where balls would float outside of your hands. Now nothing stands in your way of being able to aim and shoot with ease! 
[*] Player Login update fixes:
[list]
[*]Enables cross-platform functionality to operate properly. 
[*]“Failed to Login” message no longer displays on the Player Setup Board after you have logged in successfully (if your prior attempt was incorrect).
[/list]
[*] Removed “flickering” artifacts in the corners of the Practice Facility. The Practice Facility now features a visually cohesive court environment.
[*] Addressed an issue with the Leaderboards. Scores now populate automatically so you always know where you stand competitively.
[*] Player hands don't stick anymore!
[*] Around the World game mode: Addressed an issue with the ball rack position within the teleportation zone position when using a stationary boundary.
[/list]

[h3]Known Issues[/h3]

[list]
[*] If you start the game with your controllers disabled, you will most likely need to restart the game with your controllers enabled.
[*] Monthly Tournament Leaderboard might not display automatically in the Practice Facility. Clicking on the Monthly Tournament button though will bring up the correct Leaderboard.
[/list]

The Hoops Madness Team can be reached directly at hoops.madness@vrstudios.com with any feedback you might have. We look forward to hearing from you!
